newsitem.title: UK: Hambro Insurance says expects progress.
newsitem.headline: Hambro Insurance says expects progress.

text.p: Britain's Hambro Insurance Services Group Plc revealed a two percent drop in annual pre-tax profit on Thursday but said it expected to make progress in the current year.

"The result for the year was very encouraging given the much lower impact of exceptional weather related claims. Underlying profit before tax increased by 10 percent," chairman Christopher Sporborg said in a statement.
"In the current year we expect further underlying progress in our main operations including substantial expansion in our UK loss adjusting operation," Sporborg said.

Group pretax profits totalled 10.93 million stg in the year to March 31, 1997 while profits at the Cunningham Group rose 24 percent to 4.5 million stg and doubled at the underlying level, the company said.
Hambro said it expected substantial expansion in Cunningham UK and further progress in France.
